purpose: MAP1 native identity acceptance specifications; not a runtime/export schema
managedSubstitute: tests/MapIdentity tags its checks with these case ids and runs the managedSubstitute part against the compiled Map assembly with a synthetic native probe; managed results never mark a case natively executed

cases.given: Same local zone number in different dimensions/layers/layouts
cases.expected: Distinct identities; alias is not an author ID
cases.managedSubstitute: Addresses differing only in dimension, layer, layout, revision or local zone index stay distinct entity references
cases.nativeOnly: The creation hook reads the generated zone's real dimension/layer/local index instead of reconstructing it from alias or object name

cases.expected: Explicit creation token per placement; no name/order/proximity matching
cases.managedSubstitute: Two placements of one source lock get distinct tickets; a callback carrying the sibling placement address, or one native object claimed by both, is rejected
cases.nativeOnly: The creation ticket travels with the real instantiate call of each placement

cases.given: Old creation callback arrives after a new world begins
cases.expected: Invalidate old world and creation token
cases.managedSubstitute: Generation or world change clears associations; late callbacks fail as stale-generation/stale-world before probing
cases.nativeOnly: Real LG_Factory rebuild and drop-in timing relative to the Runtime world epoch

cases.given: Native object identifier reused after destruction
cases.expected: Reject old life even if pointer/ID is reused
cases.managedSubstitute: A reused pointer and Unity instance ID resolve only the ticket owning the current incarnation, including after a missed destroy
cases.nativeOnly: IL2CPP pointer / Unity instance ID reuse and the real liveness probe

cases.given: Two hooks report same creation token and exact live object
cases.managedSubstitute: Repeated exact observation returns map.identity.duplicate without a second allocation
cases.nativeOnly: Which real generation hooks report the same object more than once

cases.given: Same author token links to different live objects
cases.expected: Ambiguous; never choose first or nearest
cases.managedSubstitute: A second native object for one ticket quarantines the token and its native claims
cases.nativeOnly: Real generation steps that yield several candidate objects for one creation

cases.given: Name/path/position match without creation source proof
cases.managedSubstitute: An observation without a source lock records UnknownSource and never resolves, even when the object is alive
cases.nativeOnly: Objects created by vanilla or third-party generation that bypass the Forge creation ticket

cases.given: Observed source has wrong revision or hash
cases.managedSubstitute: A change of resource id, revision, source hash, file or pathId is rejected and invalidates the prior mapping
cases.nativeOnly: Reading the loaded asset's actual source identity from the installed package

cases.given: Capture budget exceeded or callbacks lost
cases.managedSubstitute: Capacity and CallbackLost gaps are explicit; missing capture is never an absence claim
cases.nativeOnly: Real callback loss and capture budget during a full level build

cases.given: Multiple areas per geomorph or node belongs to wrong area
cases.expected: Exact area/zone/dimension proof and pCourseNode round trip required
cases.managedSubstitute: Sibling areas of one placement stay distinct; an observation naming the wrong area or dimension is rejected
cases.nativeOnly: LG_Area.m_courseNode ownership and the pCourseNode round trip in a generated level
